valuationInputs.name: Beta
valuationInputs.reason: 8 steps, 16 Nov 2026. (1) Business: a holding company whose value sits in four places, weighted by their market value in mid-November 2026 (holding-company cash left out): LB Finance direct stake 286.73mn shares × Rs 159 = Rs 45.6bn (41%); Royal Ceramics 620.03mn × Rs 47.00 = Rs 29.1bn (26%); Sampath Bank 175.35mn × Rs 151.75 = Rs 26.6bn (24%); unlisted businesses (Delmege, Greener Water, Swisstek Aluminium) and The Fortress Resorts about Rs 11.0bn at cost or market (10%). (2) Damodaran's emerging-markets dataset (betaEmerg) could NOT be opened from this run; the same stand-ins as the site's Royal Ceramics and Sampath analyses: Financial Svcs. (Non-bank & Insurance) levered 0.97; Bank (Money Center) levered 0.70; Building Materials unlevered 0.90. (3) Finance and bank stakes use the sectors' levered betas without relevering (as the brief says for finance companies and banks). The Royal Ceramics stake uses the site's Royal Ceramics beta, 1.12 (relevered, and including its own LB Finance stake). The unlisted operating businesses use Royal Ceramics' relevered building-materials figure, 1.28, as a stand-in (their own debt isn't disclosed separately). Weighted: 0.41 × 0.97 + 0.26 × 1.12 + 0.24 × 0.70 + 0.10 × 1.28 = 0.98. (4) Local 5-year betas: only one found, StockAnalysis 0.87 (5Y, undated web-search extract; page not opened). TradingView's 1.10 is a 1-year beta and is ignored. Fewer than the 3 sources the rule asks for. (5) Higher of 0.98 and 0.87 = 0.98. (6) Within 0.3-2. (7) Into the formula by scripts/reinvestment.py. Provisional: refresh in January 2027 with Damodaran's file and three verified local 5-year betas.

valuationInputs.name: Methods used
valuationInputs.value: Sum of the parts, P/E, justified P/B, residual income
valuationInputs.reason: Holding company whose consolidated accounts are three-quarters LB Finance, so no whole-company DCF (Royal Ceramics' operating DCF is inside its site value). Dividend model left out: payout 26%, gives Rs 20-29.

valuationInputs.reason: Book Rs 63.35bn × 51.75% = Rs 32.78bn (March 2026, AR p. 339). Justified P/B with ROE 17 / 20%, growth 5 / 6%, cost of equity 19.7 / 18.2% (beta 0.97). Bull at Rs 159 (HNB Stockbrokers table, 9 Nov 2026). Total shares about 554.1mn, worked out from the 51.75% stake.

changeLog.basedOn: Annual Report 2025/26 (amended) and interims to 30 Jun and 30 Sep 2026 (CSE downloads)
changeLog.summary: Requested from Telegram (/add VONE.N0000). First analysis. Research record built from the three downloaded reports (FY 2025 and FY 2026 annual figures, holdings, Q1, Q2 and H1 FY2027). Beta 0.98 (provisional, value-weighted look-through; one local 5-year beta of 0.87) gives cost of equity 18.3%. Methods: sum of the parts 80.9, P/E 53.2, justified P/B 58.0, residual income 49.9; dividend model and whole-company DCF left out. Business tests 2 of 4 (fails returns and cash): category 3, avoid for now. Price Rs 88.80 is the 30 Sep 2026 close from the interim report (the current CSE close couldn't be fetched); LB Finance price Rs 159 from a 9 Nov 2026 broker table; group capex booked and working-capital change not recorded (mixed with LB Finance's lending); Fortress purchase cost not in the reports read. Fair value Rs 60.50, buy Rs 51.40, strong buy Rs 45.40.
